# Infinite Sauna

Infinite Sauna is an independent, source-documented sauna specification database updated weekly.

## Primary resources
- Complete model database: https://infinitesauna.com/database/
- Electrical requirements database: https://infinitesauna.com/electrical/
- Downloadable CSV and JSON: https://infinitesauna.com/data/
- Verification methodology: https://infinitesauna.com/methodology/
- Latest dataset release: https://infinitesauna.com/changes/
- Brand directory: https://infinitesauna.com/brands/
- Comparison tool: https://infinitesauna.com/compare/

## Interpretation
- "Not verified" means no reliable model-specific value is currently available.
- "Not applicable" means a field does not apply to that sauna heat type.
- EMF terminology and stated capacity reproduce manufacturer claims unless otherwise specified.
- Electrical and installation details must be checked against the exact current manufacturer manual.

## Citation
Suggested attribution: Infinite Sauna, "Sauna Model Database," https://infinitesauna.com/data/
